sources.title: Weak form quadrature shell elements based on absolute nodal coordinate formulation
sources.authors: Zixuan He; Huayi Li; Hongzhi Zhong
sources.checked_scope: Text of section 2.1 equations 1-3 and section 3.1 equations 16-19: EL2 thickness quadratic field, Lobatto collocation and thickness Gauss integration. Full paper and all examples not audited.
sources.scope_limit: Only one m=n=5 low-order realization and explicit UVLAS extensions tested; no claim to reproduce all paper elements.

sources.title: Higher-order MITC general shell elements
sources.checked_scope: Pages 3732-3735, sections 2.1-2.3; Figure 3 visually rendered and checked: Gauss3x4 tying for 11/13, transposed for 22/23, Gauss3x3 for 12. Introduction reliability conditions read.
sources.scope_limit: UVLAS uses Q4 EL2, 3D material and new projection/mean constraints; original MITC16 implementation and its validation are not reproduced.
